subject: Outstanding Invoice 7721 — payment orchestration & leadership touchpoint
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@senecahealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Outstanding Invoice 7721 — 30+ days overdue

Hi Elena —

Following up on invoice 7721 (due 2027-09-30) — the balance of $84,320 remains unpaid and fell into our past-due pipeline last week. Our AR playbook asks that we align on a payment path by close of business Friday so we can avoid a formal collections hold.

We want to be pragmatic: if there are genuine remit issues on your side (entity routing, WHT, VAT), we can accept a staggered remit plan while Seneca resolves internal approvals. If possible, please confirm:
- Which entity will pay (US vs UK entity)?
- Any tax withholding or VAT reverse-charge concerns?
- Proposed earliest payment date or a short payment schedule if you need it split.

I’ve cc’d Neha from Finance to confirm what evidence we need for tax clearing and Rishi from Sales for any commercial flexibility. We can provide a short two-installment schedule if that helps.

Attachments: invoice_7721_20270930.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@senecahealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Martin Blake <martin.blake@senecahealth.com>, procurement@senecahealth.com
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Outstanding Invoice 7721 — 30+ days overdue

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for flagging. We acknowledge the invoice and are actively working the payment. A couple of points that caused the delay:
1) The payment team paused remittance because our accounting team is clarifying which Seneca legal entity should be billed for Q3 services; several internal POs are being consolidated.
2) There is an open question about VAT handling for this line item — our AP is asking for your VAT breakdown per entity and a UK VAT registration confirmation.

I’ll push procurement to confirm entity routing today and share a hard date. Can Neha confirm what tax documentation is sufficient (VAT registration number copy, supplier declaration, etc.)? If we can agree on a split plan, procurement will likely expedite the first installment.

Best,
Elena
Head of Procurement
Seneca Health
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@senecahealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Outstanding Invoice 7721 — documentation and next steps

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the quick reply. For VAT clearance / entity routing we typically need one of the following:
- Copy of the paying entity's VAT registration (if EU/UK) plus confirmation of remit currency and bank details; OR
- A procurement confirmation email from the paying legal entity that references the PO and authorizes remittance to Redwood US (if they want to pay the US entity).

If Seneca needs, we can accept an initial partial payment (50%) to unblock services while entity paperwork is confirmed. I’ve attached a short spreadsheet with the proposed staggered plan that includes exact dates and amounts we can accept and the accounting reference fields we require.

Attachments: proposed-staggered-plan-7721.xlsx

Neha Kapoor
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@senecahealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Outstanding Invoice 7721 — need leadership help for payment cadence

Marissa / Rishi —

Looping you in. Procurement is delaying entity confirmation which is blocking remittance. Elena has indicated procurement will expedite if we accept a split (first 50% immediately, remainder on confirmation).

Request: can we approve a one-time staggered schedule for Seneca (50% on or before 2027-11-10, remainder 2027-11-30) without changing pricing or terms? If yes, Marissa, please confirm and I’ll propose the schedule formally. If we need an exec touchpoint (CFO-level) I can coordinate a short call with their CFO, Martin Blake — he’s cc’d earlier.

Quote from playbook: accept partial payment + require evidence (bank remittance screenshot or payment advice) to lift credit hold.

Thanks,
Priyom
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@senecahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Nov 2027 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Outstanding Invoice 7721 — payment cadence approved with conditions

Thanks all — after quick review with Finance and Sales leadership: we will accept the staggered plan with the conditions below. Priyom, please get Elena to confirm in writing and request a payment remittance receipt for the first installment. Once we confirm the 50% payment cleared, we will lift any pending service restrictions.

Conditions:
- 50% payment of $42,160 by 2027-11-10 to Redwood US bank account on the spreadsheet (match reference field: INV7721-SENECA). Evidence required: bank statement screenshot or SWIFT confirmation.
- Remaining 50% payable by 2027-11-30. If entity routing changes (Seneca pays from UK entity), Seneca must provide VAT registration copy and remittance instructions by 2027-11-15.
- If we have no payment evidence by 2027-11-11 we will schedule a 15-minute escalation call with Seneca execs (Rishi to lead) to preserve revenue and agree on plan.

Attachments: payment-evidence-template.txt (template for what we need)

Marissa Cole
Director, Credit & Collections
Redwood Inference
